facts.status_note: Listed as gone by FireLookout.org; no removal date, cause or remains are described by any source read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1961 clipping gives 3,050 feet above sea level; the register gives 3,013 ft (918 m). The record keeps the register figure and the story reports both.
An August 1942 clipping mentions the fire tower at Burning Rock, while a November 1954 clipping says the tower opened that day. No build year is recorded; both mentions are events.
A 1957 clipping names the State Conservation Commission; the register now names the West Virginia Division of Forestry. Both are shown.

notes_for_editor: Only the clippings page, the FFLOS register entry and the FireLookout.org list describe this site. The 1961 clipping gives the tower height as approximately 14 feet; left out, since no other source gives a height and it is unclear what the figure measures. No removal date, cause or present condition found. The 1942 and 1954 clippings disagree about when a tower stood there. The state tower list PDF (wvenc-f5.wvnet.edu) could not be reached (DNS failure), so it was not checked and may hold more staffing detail. The WVU photo catalog entries returned 403 and were not used.
